annotations.title: Create a Verifiable Travel Rule Screening Packet

description: Screen the originator and beneficiary of a crypto transfer (wallets, plus names and countries when given) and store the result as a Travel Rule packet. The strictest threshold among the parties' countries applies (EU/EEA 0, Japan about 700, otherwise the FATF Recommendation 16 de-minimis of 1,000 USD); pass amount_usd to learn whether it applies. Returns a packetId, a free verification URL and an EdDSA-signed attestation valid for 90 days for the counterparty VASP. Use it when a transfer needs a Travel Rule record; use screen_wallet for a quick address check, and verify_travel_rule_packet to check a packet you received. Each call stores a new packet; names are stored only as keyed hashes and never returned, wallet addresses are stored. Costs $0.005 USDC per successful call via x402 on Base; unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired result and failed calls are not charged.

amount_usd.description: Optional transfer value in USD; without it travelRule.applies is null

beneficiary_address.description: Beneficiary wallet address, 10-256 letters, digits or ':'

beneficiary_name.description: Optional beneficiary name; screened and stored only as a keyed hash

originator_address.description: Originator wallet address, 10-256 letters, digits or ':'

originator_country.description: Optional originator ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country; sets the applicable threshold (e.g. US, SG, JP)

originator_name.description: Optional originator name; screened against watchlists and stored only as a keyed hash

purpose.description: Optional purpose of the transfer, up to 200 characters

name: create_travel_rule_packet

attestation.description: EdDSA-signed JWT (no names) verifiable offline with the keys at /trust/jwks

beneficiary.description: wallet, name and jurisdiction screening results

lists_as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) each screening list was last updated, keyed by list (e.g. us_ofac_sdn, eu_consolidated); check it before relying on a clear result

originator.description: wallet, name and jurisdiction screening results

packetId.description: Packet id (TR- + 22 characters) to share with the counterparty

travelRule.description: applies (true/false, null without amount), thresholdUsd, thresholdBasis, amountUsd, note

verifyUrl.description: Free public URL where the counterparty verifies the packet

anyOf.description: Returned with isError=true when payment is needed: sign one of `accepts` with an x402 client and repeat the call with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

accepts.description: Accepted payment options: scheme 'exact', network 'eip155:8453' (Base), USDC asset, amount in 6-decimal atomic units, payTo address

error.description: Why payment is required, or why the submitted payment was rejected

extensions.description: x402 protocol extensions (e.g. bazaar discovery metadata)

resource.description: The paid resource: url, description, mimeType

anyOf.title: x402 PaymentRequired
